cover: What to build first in your MVP

slides.title: Find the one loop
slides.body: The single user journey that proves the idea works. That is what goes into the first version.

slides.title: Write the rest down
slides.body: Every other feature goes on a written list. Good ideas mid-build go there too, so the launch date holds.

slides.title: Build the loop properly
slides.body: Accounts, payments, backups and a deploy pipeline from day one, even in a small first version.

slides.title: Skip the scale you don't have
slides.body: Build simply, with a cost model for 100 and 10,000 users, and rewrite once the product has earned it.

slides.title: Own it from the first commit
slides.body: The repo, accounts and deploy button are yours, so a new engineer can pick it up without calling us.
